33014282.model_family: random forest with two-step (shadow + stepwise) feature selection on GLM-derived fMRI features
33014282.clinical_problem: predicting response to pivotal response treatment (a behavioral intervention) in autism spectrum disorder
33014282.patient_population: young children with autism spectrum disorder undergoing task-based fMRI (n=20)
33014282.model_description: Task-based fMRI comparing two conditions is analyzed voxel-by-voxel with a general linear model to obtain t-statistics; a two-step feature-selection process (a random-forest-based 'shadow' method followed by stepwise selection) picks the most informative voxels. A random-forest regression model then predicts treatment outcome for pivotal response treatment in young children with autism, evaluated with leave-one-out cross-validation.
33014282.headline_result: the proposed pipeline generated the highest accuracy compared with other standard regression methods (exact accuracy value not given)

33103165.model_family: curriculum-learning-based NLP image-captioning model (dual image/text curriculum)
33103165.clinical_problem: automated captioning/description of fetal ultrasound images
33103165.patient_population: fetal ultrasound examinations, using real-world ultrasound video paired with synchronized sonographer speech recordings
33103165.model_description: A natural-language-processing captioning model learns to generate text descriptions of fetal ultrasound images. Training uses real ultrasound video synchronized with transcribed sonographer speech. A 'dual-curriculum' strategy orders training examples by image difficulty (Wasserstein distance) and text difficulty (tf-idf) to improve learning from the relatively small ultrasound image-caption dataset.
33103165.headline_result: curriculum learning improved all performance metrics over stochastic mini-batch training, for both image classification and image captioning

33128629.model_family: multi-layer perceptron (MLP) classifier on mutual-information connectivity features
33128629.model_description: Cortical activity recorded via fMRI is analyzed by computing mutual-information coefficients between pairs of anatomically identified cortical regions. Pairs of regions with biologically significant inter-connectivity are selected as inputs to a small multi-layer perceptron classifier, which localizes the epileptic seizure focus to one of eight cortical lobes.
33128629.headline_result: small MLP achieved good percentages of successful classification (exact figure not given)

33166251.model_family: dilated convolutional neural network combined with a relation network
33166251.clinical_problem: predicting preoperative language impairment and postoperative seizure outcome in children undergoing epilepsy surgery
33166251.patient_population: 51 children with focal epilepsy undergoing preoperative diffusion-weighted imaging connectome analysis before epilepsy surgery
33166251.model_description: Preoperative diffusion-weighted imaging is used to build whole-brain structural connectomes. A 'dilated CNN + RN' model (a dilated convolutional network combined with a relation network) reasons about sparsely distributed axonal-connection dependencies to predict expressive and receptive language-impairment scores and to classify postoperative seizure outcome (freedom vs. recurrence) in children with focal epilepsy. Gradient-based activation maps highlight the brain regions driving each prediction.
33166251.headline_result: average improvement of 90.2% and 97.3% in predicting expressive and receptive language scores, and 2.2% and 4% improvement in classifying seizure freedom and recurrence, versus other state-of-the-art algorithms
33166251.study_design: retrospective single-center technical development and validation

34120738.headline_result: best model achieved 86.36% accuracy, 81.82% sensitivity, 90.91% specificity, AUC 0.9132 (SVM) / 0.9318 (logistic regression); radiologists correctly classified 87 of 113 cases and could not decide on 20

34232898.model_family: attention-guided CNN with joint age-distribution learning and expectation regression
34232898.patient_population: children undergoing hand radiography for bone age assessment (RSNA pediatric bone age dataset)
34232898.model_description: A classification model learns attention maps that automatically localize discriminative hand regions (the whole hand, then carpal bones, then metacarpal bones) without extra manual annotation. The cropped regions are aggregated, and bone age is estimated using joint age-distribution learning with expectation regression rather than direct regression, to address ambiguity in the age label space. Evaluated on the RSNA pediatric bone age dataset.
34232898.headline_result: competitive results versus existing state-of-the-art deep learning methods that require manual annotation (exact error value not given)

34408203.model_description: fMRI responses while viewing angry versus fearful faces are measured, and an AdaBoost machine-learning classifier is trained on regional brain activity to distinguish anxious from non-anxious children, with the right temporal pole emerging as the most discriminative region. 34502710.model_family: CNN with continuous wavelet transform, local and global classification (computer-aided diagnosis framework)
34502710.patient_population: 50 toddlers with autism spectrum disorder and 50 typically developing toddlers undergoing task-based fMRI during a speech-response task

The system produces both local (per brain region) and fused global autism diagnosis, plus a brain map indicating region-wise severity to support personalized diagnosis and treatment planning.

34700253.patient_population: participants from the public ABIDE I resting-state fMRI dataset (n=871); exact ages not stated in the abstract

35023255.model_description: T2-weighted brain MRIs from very preterm infants with post-hemorrhagic hydrocephalus are automatically segmented into lateral ventricles, external CSF, white and cortical gray matter, brainstem, and cerebellum using a Bayesian U-Net with 3D spatial concrete dropout, which also produces a voxel-wise uncertainty map.
